card.name: Inside words like manger and manager
card.fires_on: Word pieces that continue a word beginning with "man" or "mang", such as manger, mangrove, manager(s) and mangeur. It also fires on a few names and long foreign words.

modes.description: The word managers or Manage following words like general or land.
